title: Two-minute breathing reset
detail: A quiet pause for you — not a workout.
stageNote: Gentle for most parents. Stop anytime you feel unwell.
clearanceCopy: If you have had recent surgery, chest pain, dizziness, or your clinician advised rest — pause and check with them before starting.
stopCopy: If you feel dizzy, short of breath, chest pain, or anything that worries you — stop and rest. Seek care if it continues.

steps.title: Find a soft spot
steps.body: Sit or stand somewhere steady. Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders.

steps.title: Breathe in for 4
steps.body: Inhale gently through your nose. Count slowly: 1 · 2 · 3 · 4.

steps.title: Breathe out for 6
steps.body: Exhale through your mouth, longer than the inhale. Count: 1 · 2 · 3 · 4 · 5 · 6.

steps.title: Repeat a few times
steps.body: Do this about six rounds — or fewer if that is all you have. Stopping early is fine.

title: Side-lying rest cue
detail: A soft reset for third-trimester hips and breath — not a workout.
stageNote: Pregnancy-safe rest cue. Stop anytime you feel unwell.
clearanceCopy: If you have pregnancy complications, bleeding, reduced fetal movement, chest pain, dizziness, or your clinician advised rest — pause and check with them before starting.
stopCopy: If you feel dizzy, short of breath, chest pain, contractions that worry you, or anything that feels wrong — stop and rest. Seek care if it continues.

steps.title: Lie on your side
steps.body: Prefer the left side if comfortable. Place a pillow between your knees.

steps.title: Soften your jaw
steps.body: Unclench, drop your shoulders, and let your belly feel supported.

steps.title: Breathe gently
steps.body: Inhale for 4, exhale for 6. Do about six rounds — fewer is fine.
